description: Detects the technologies a website uses (CMS, ecommerce platform, JS framework, web server, CDN/hosting, analytics, ad pixels, chat, payments, consent tools) from one page load. Free preview tier: technology names and categories. The paid x402 endpoint /v1/detect adds versions, confidence and evidence plus email / DNS / hosting providers and verified SaaS from public DNS.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL or a bare domain, e.g. https://laravel.com or shopify.com

name: detect_stack
title: What is this website built with?
